_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Time Compliance Technical Order (TCTO) Reporting
summary: Requires contractors possessing or maintaining Air Force engines and components to report TCTO compliance, de-compliance, and kits-parts-tools status to the Comprehensive Engine Management System (CEMS) to keep the worldwide inventory complete and accurate.
applicable_forms: DD Form 2875 for Air Force (AF) Portal access, DD Form 2875 for Comprehensive Engine Management System (CEMS) access, Non-Disclosure Statement for CEMS, DoD Information Assurance Awareness (IAA) training certificate and CEMS TCTO Status Report
use_relationship:
As directed by the AF propulsion community, all organizations possessing and/or maintaining AF engines or components on behalf of the AF, TCTO reporting is required to report modifications and changes to AF engines, installed assemblies and components to the Comprehensive Engine Management System (CEMS). TCTO reporting ensures that the worldwide inventory is complete and accurate.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the requirements, to include access to the Internet, AF Portal, and CEMS for the purpose of reporting TCTO status for engines, assemblies, and components. It also contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data reporting generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
b. This DID is applicable when contractors report TCTO status data to CEMS as designated by the AF propulsion community.
c. Publications referenced below are available on the CEMS web site, https://www.my.af.mil/gimmsprod/cpmo/ , at CEMS Program Management Office (PMO), Tinker AFB, OK.
d. This DID supersedes DI-MGMT-81325B.

distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract. Definitions and/or descriptions of the various data authorized for entry in the specified blocks of the CEMS TCTO Status Report are contained in United States AF Technical Order (T.O.) 00-25-254-1.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: Unless an agreed upon approved interface exists, all required input is via the reporting process known as CEMS.

children.title: Access to CEMS:
children.content: In order to accomplish the required access to government computer systems for the purpose of reporting as referenced above, the following is required:

children.title: A minimum of a favorable National Agency Check
children.content: A minimum of a favorable National Agency Check with Inquiries (NACI) is required for any contractor accessing a Department of Defense (DoD) Information System. Procedures concerning Industrial Security Clearances and Investigations can be found at http://www.dss.mil/isp/index.html.

children.title: AF Portal access.
children.content: A DD Form 2875 must be completed to obtain an AF Portal account. Signed copies of this form must be sent by signed email to the AF Portal Program Office, gcssaf.opsandsupport@gunter.af.mil, or faxed to the AF Portal Program Office (DSN 596-5771, Commercial 334 416-5771; Option 7). DD Form 2875, as well as additional information may be obtained at https://www.my.af.mil . Input a search for 'DD Form 2875' to access the form.

children.title: CEMS access.
children.content:
After AF Portal access is obtained, a separate DD Form 2875, a Nondisclosure Statement, and a copy of the DoD Information Assurance Awareness (IAA) training certificate must be completed requesting access to CEMS and emailed to CEMS.PMO.Security@us.af.mil.
- The DD Form 2875 and Nondisclosure Statement can be downloaded from https://www.my.af.mil/gimmsprod/cpmo/ by clicking on the "Forms" folder and then clicking "Contractor Access Forms." Instructions are included with the form.
- For '.mil' users, the DoD IAA CyberAwareness Challenge (Course: ZZ133098) can be completed at https://golearn.adls.af.mil/, click on "Course List" then click the + sign next to "Annual Total Force Awareness Training (TFAT)" then click on the course title above. Contact ADSL at adls@us.af.mil, (210) 652-3274 or DSN 487-3274 for help. For '.com' users, the course can be completed at http://iase.disa.mil/eta/cyberchallenge/launchPage.htm .

children.title: You can only access CEMS via the AF Portal.
children.content: The CEMS PMO, 405-734-7874, DSN: 884-7874, or Toll Free: 1-800-956-7351, should be contacted for further information.

children.title: Inputs to CEMS:
children.content: Description of Entries on CEMS TCTO Status Report document. This form is used to identify the compliance, de-compliance (reversal), and kits-parts-tools availability, etc, for a TCTO data code.

children.title: CII.
children.content: The Configured Item Identifier for the Serial Number being reported.

children.title: Serial Number.
children.content: Enter the Serial Number that the TCTO status applies to.

children.title: Data Code.
children.content: Enter the seven-position data code (NNNNNNN). This code can be found on the upper right corner of the TCTO cover page.

children.title: Status/How Mal.
children.content: If applicable, enter the appropriate three-position HOW MAL (NNN).

children.title: Status Date.
children.content: Enter the Julian Date (YYJJJ) the TCTO compliance or status change was accomplished.

children.title: Accomplishing SRAN.
children.content: Enter the four-position SRAN that accomplished the TCTO action.

children.title: Reversal Code.
children.content: Enter X to reverse a TCTO status from closed (codes 01-05, 22) to open (codes 06-21, 24) status.

children.title: Actual Manhours.
children.content: Enter the number of manhours expended to accomplish the TCTO action to the nearest tenth of an hour (e.g 0001.5). This field is required for TCTO status codes 01, 02, and 03. This field is optional for partially complied statuses 06, 07, and 18.

children.title: Work Center.
children.content: Enter the five-position work center code that performed the TCTO action.

children.title: Work Order Number.
children.content: Enter the eight-position work order number.

children.title: Old Part Number.
children.content: Enter current part number of the Serial Number being reported. On non-parts tracked engines, enter the IMDS TMSM in lieu of the part number.

children.title: New Part Number.
children.content: If applicable, enter the new part number when the TCTO directs a change to a new part number upon compliance. If applicable for non-parts tracked engines, enter the new IMDS TMSM upon compliance in lieu of part number.
